# Clause choice tables (generated by `tools/clause_choice.py`)

Letters: E = expect, A = also_ok[0], B = also_ok[1], X = scorer rejects it or the run
failed; lower case = accepted only by the MONA same-task check. Level cells hold one letter
per run (3 runs). `uniform` = expected expect share if each right answer were a uniform pick
among the card's listed answers; p = two-sided binomial test of the expect count against it.

## Expect share among right answers

| set | cards | generations | right | expect [95% Wilson CI] | uniform | p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FARM final run, all | 15 | 36 | 36 | 24/36 = 67% [50%, 80%] | 48% | 0.03 |
| FARM final run, answers listed before it | 9 | 15 | 15 | 11/15 = 73% [48%, 89%] | 50% | 0.12 |
| FARM final run, an answer added from it | 6 | 21 | 21 | 13/21 = 62% [41%, 79%] | 47% | 0.19 |
| levels: none | 8 | 33 | 22 | 12/22 = 55% [35%, 73%] | 50% | 0.83 |
| levels: low | 8 | 33 | 32 | 18/32 = 56% [39%, 72%] | 50% | 0.6 |
| levels: medium | 8 | 33 | 33 | 18/33 = 55% [38%, 70%] | 50% | 0.73 |

## Do repeated runs agree?

- FARM, one card's wordings (answers listed before): 2/2 = 100% [34%, 100%] groups agree; a uniform pick would make 12% agree (one-sided binomial p = 0.016).
- FARM, one card's wordings (all cards): 2/7 = 29% [8%, 64%] groups agree; a uniform pick would make 11% agree (one-sided binomial p = 0.18).
- levels, one case at one level (3 runs): 51/52 = 98% [90%, 100%] groups agree; a uniform pick would make 27% agree (one-sided binomial p = 8.1e-28).
- levels, one case over low to max (12 runs): 11/11 = 100% [74%, 100%] groups agree; a uniform pick would make 0% agree (one-sided binomial p = 9.8e-37).
